LanguageData.CK_StorageTab.label: Warehouse
LanguageData.CK_StorageTab.generalDescription: Research high-density storage, warehouse cores and conveyor logistics.
LanguageData.CK_StorageTier1.label: tier 1 vertical warehouse
LanguageData.CK_StorageTier1.description: Stackable items hold 10x their normal limit. Research cost 800; requires Electricity.
LanguageData.CK_StorageTier2.label: tier 2 vertical warehouse
LanguageData.CK_StorageTier2.description: Another 3x (30x total). Unlocks the vertical warehouse core, which cools its enclosed room toward 4 degrees C when powered.
LanguageData.CK_StorageTier3.label: tier 3 vertical warehouse
LanguageData.CK_StorageTier3.description: Another 2x (60x total). The core can be set from -20 to 30 degrees C.
